groups.activity: pledge to New Loka; farm affinity-dense Grineer missions

rows.label: pledge to New Loka
rows.note: buy the sigil at any Relay enclave

conditions: The daily cap (16,000 + 500 x Mastery Rank) is shared across all six syndicates; only the pledged syndicate earns the 15% conversion.
Perrin Sequence is the only other pledge that also feeds New Loka standing, at 7.5%; every other syndicate pledge feeds it 0%.
bonuses: Three daily New Loka Syndicate Alerts and their Seed medallions (500/1,000/5,000 each) bypass the daily cap entirely.
Universal Syndicate Medallions from Disruption are worth 1,000 standing with any syndicate.

disclosures.title: build a medallion loadout
disclosures.body: Loot Radar on frame and companion, a vacuum-type companion (a Sentinel is best), and a wide-AoE frame that breaks containers turns any mission into a Seed hunt alongside the affinity farm. Max-range Limbo casting Cataclysm twice was the popular pick.

groups.meta: for the Rank 4 and Rank 5 sacrifices

groups.activity: rank up, then buy Sancti Magistar at Flawless

rows.label: Sancti Magistar
rows.note: 125,000 standing; arrives built, no Foundry step

conditions: Rank-ups spend the standing you've banked; after hitting Flawless you're back to 0 and still need 125,000 more for the weapon.
Sancti Magistar is never the free rank-up reward; it is always a 125,000-standing purchase on top of reaching Flawless.

disclosures.title: total cost from zero
disclosures.body: About 365,000 New Loka standing, 940,000 credits, 5 Aya, a Forma, an Orokin Reactor, 2 Fieldron Samples and 1,000 Ferrite.
